context.transcript:
Good morning.
As you know, we pledge timely delivery to all our customers.
Since you deliver packages by bike in the city every day, we want your feedback on a new cargo bike.
It has a storage unit attached that will allow you to carry many more packages than usual.
We're currently borrowing a few from the manufacturer to test out before we purchase them.
So, today you'll be using them on your regular routes.
Just a reminder, please lock up the bikes while making a stop to keep them safe.
There's a lock and key attached to each one.
context.transcript_translation:
早上好。
如您所知，我们承诺向所有客户提供及时的交付。
由于您每天都在市区用自行车运送包裹，我们想就一辆新的货运自行车征求您的反馈意见。
它带有一个存储单元，可以让您携带比平时更多的包裹。
目前我们从制造商那里借了几辆来测试，然后再购买。
所以，今天您将使用它们进行日常路线的运输。
提醒一下，在停下来时请锁好自行车以保持安全。
每辆车都附带了锁和钥匙。
